item.title: Feature Article: Caryl Bosman, 'Homes for Everyone'
item.description: Many planning rationalities and practices adopted in the production of particular ideals of community frequently deny the existence of power relations, assume mutual cohesion between subjects and result in built landscapes that often reflect specific lifestyles and alienate, limit or deny others. The ensuing genealogies highlight some of the taken-for-granted, normalised planning practices that assisted in the creation the Golden Grove Development.
